grade1-2: Use counting, ordering and basic arithmetic in everyday situations
Explore and describe shapes and spatial relationships
Collect and sort data and read simple charts
grade3-4: Calculate with whole numbers using informal and formal methods
Measure and compare using standard units
Read and create bar charts and tables
grade5-7: Carry out arithmetic with whole numbers, fractions, decimals and negative numbers
Use variables and simple algebraic expressions
Explore properties of geometric figures and coordinate systems
grade8-10: Work with linear equations, inequalities and functions
Use geometric reasoning including Pythagoras theorem
Apply statistics: mean, median, mode, standard deviation
Work with powers, roots and scientific notation
Understand and use proportionality and percentage in real contexts
